votes.motion: Endorse the ANR Plan for 871 and 915 Northfield Road.
votes.quote: p. bertram made motion to endorse the anr plan for 871 and 915 northfield road, t. cole seconded, all aye.

votes.motion: Send a letter to the Building Commissioner informing him of the prior nine-lot subdivision and requesting a determination whether the tenth lot triggers the 10% affordability threshold.
votes.quote: requesting a determination if the creation of this tenth lot triggers the 10% affordability threshold under the bylaw, t. cole seconded, all aye.

votes.motion: Approve the ANR Plan for 41 and 47 Reservoir Road.
votes.quote: t. cole made motion to approve the anr plan for 41 and 47 reservoir road, p. bertram seconded, all aye.

votes.motion: Approve the proposed common driveway for 41 and 47 Reservoir Road with the stipulation that the culvert meet a minimum vehicle weight of 50,000 pounds and that it be so certified.
votes.quote: with the stipulation that the culvert meet a minimum vehicle weight of 50,000 pounds and that it be so certified, m. thompson seconded, all aye.
p. bertram made motion to approve, t. cole seconded, all aye.
p. bertram made motion to adjourn, t. cole seconded, all aye.

decisions.decision: Hearing on 1325 Massachusetts Avenue was continued to February 10.
decisions.quote: hearing was continued to february 10 th.

decisions.decision: The Board asked the Land Use Director to send a letter to the Select Board requesting a meeting on the Brooks House, Library, and school buildings.
decisions.quote: the board asked a. burney to send a letter to the select board requesting a meeting

decisions.decision: The Board felt the APDC and the TCP Building Design Committee should be invited to that Select Board meeting.
decisions.quote: the board feels it would be beneficial for both the apdc and the tcp building design committee to be invited to that meeting.

decisions.decision: The Board was of the opinion that a scenic road general bylaw, including fines, should be created.
decisions.quote: that a scenic road general bylaw, to include fines, should be created.

decisions.decision: Board consensus on the Earth Removal bylaw was a threshold of 1,500 cubic yards to trigger a permit.
decisions.quote: board consensus was to go with a threshold of 1,500 cubic yards

decisions.decision: Earth Removal discussion to continue at the next Board meeting.
decisions.quote: discussion will continue at the next board meeting.

decisions.decision: The Land Use Director will seek legal input on the Earth Removal bylaw.
decisions.quote: a. burney will seek legal input.

decisions.decision: Rules and Regulations Governing the Subdivision of Land tabled until after the Warrant closes in March.
decisions.quote: tabled until after warrant closes in march.

decisions.decision: The Land Use Director will keep the Board updated on the MGL Ch. 41 Sec. 81D master plan population projection work.
decisions.quote: a. burney clarified what the board is requesting and will keep the board updated.

decisions.decision: Stormwater Bylaw discussion (fees and measurable goals) tabled to February 10.
P. Bertram will send an educational brochure to the Land Use Director for public distribution.
decisions.quote: which she will send to a. burney for public distribution.
